name: Verordnung zur Bestimmung Kritischer Infrastrukturen nach dem BSI-Gesetz (BSI-Kritisverordnung — BSI-KritisV)
description: Ordinance under the BSI Act defining sector thresholds and covered critical facilities across energy, water, food, IT/telecommunications, health, finance/insurance, transport, and municipal waste management.
